watches.name: Avalon Kelp Diver 44m
watches.description: - SOLD - Contact Us to order a custom like this. Avalon Kelp Diver 44mm celebrates the green water kelp forests in the cool Pacific waters of California. Descending into the kelp forest is one of the most majestic and surreal aquatic experiences you can have. The flow of the current sets the giant kelp into a soothing dance - twisting with the light and the wildlife who effortlessly slip in and out of the forest as they go about their day. This model features our 44mm reclaimed bronze case with an emerald green sunray dial and a bronze chapter ring, bronze hands and a lollipop seconds hand with white lum fill. The bracelet links are reclaimed bronze and "seaglass" - our custom resin made with reclaimed ghosts nets (old nylon fishing nets we take from the sea) with a bronze buckle. Rated at 300 meter water resist, this watch is made to stay on your wrist in, on and under the water. This watch can be personalized and customized. We also offer patina work to give you that vintage look right out of the box. This is a one off custom drop made for the collector or the enthusiast to enjoy. It's bronze patina will evolve as you year it and can be returned to its original shine with a simple bath of ketchup! Assembled in Encinitas, CA 🇺🇸 Ships with: - Travel Case - Tobacco Horween Leather Rally Strap - Bronze / Seaglass Link Bracelet - Numbered Certificate of Authenticity Specifications: - 44m Bronze case, 300m rated - Eta 2824-2 movement with custom rotor - Sunray Green dial with datebox - Super Luminova Indices - Sapphire Glass top and bottom - Screwed Down Crown - Unidirectional Bezel Timer - 22mm Lugs

watches.name: Kudmai - Bronze + Steel Case / Black Dial
watches.description: "Kudmai" means "Reborn" in Thai language. This watch combines our reclaimed bronze with Swiss-Made Automatic Movement. It is a humble nod to the classic dive watch. Featuring a 316L stainless steel case and bracelet + contrasting bronze bezel and center links made from vintage bronze marine propellers. “Our Bronze” is a custom CuSN8 formulation we developed from reclaimed bronze marine propellors. Kudmai ships with a luxury reclaimed wood box made from our vintage boats, a rubber dive strap, premium leather band, travel case and coffee table book that shares the story of how [and why] we made this watch. Designed to wear with the wearer, a bronze watch is a special type of timepiece. Its color will gradually turn from a glowing warm bronze to a deep patina depending on where it's taken. Best of all, the patina can be removed and its original luster can be restored with a simple cleaning process. Featuring a screwed down crown and unidirectional dive bezel this 25 jewel, 42 hour powered watch will perform as needed anywhere you feel free to roam. Customizable Sizing and Strap Replacement on Request

watches.name: Haiku Koa Wood Bronzo
watches.description: - Sold - Contact Us To Custom Order This Watch. (30-45 Days Delivery) Haiku is a majestic and lush community on the island of Maui. Spend some time on this wonderful land and meet a culture so rich in history and deep in its own roots you will find yourself in a humble debt to its gravity. Haiku is especially blessed with a designer's approach to blending architecture into the tropical landscape and a balance of materials in construction. This custom made bronze watch features a dial and center link on the bracelet crafted from Koa wood that was received from a close friend. A fallen branch from a winter storm made its way to Encinitas, CA from the hills of Haiku as a token of ohana and the connection between craftsmen & watermen across the Pacific Ocean. We don't make alot of watches with Sellita movements, but when we do, we make them badass. This watch was custom made in an effort to bring more affordable, high quality timepieces to the our range and it carries our full 5 year warranty and white glove customer support. Assembled in Encinitas, CA 🇺🇸 Ships With: - 44mm Bronze Case + Koa Wood Dial & Bronze Chapter Ring - Sellita SW200 Movement With Custom Bronze Rotor - 22m Horween Leather Rally Strap - 22m Reclaimed Bronze Bracelet with Up-cycled Koa Wood Dial - Travel Case - Certificate Of Authenticity - Sapphire Glass Cover & Sapphire Glass Display Caseback

watches.name: Tres Puentes - Carbon Fiber Beast Mode Bezel
watches.description: In 1733 the Tres Puentes, a triple decker ship in the Spanish fleet ran aground and wrecked in stormy seas off the coast of Florida. It carried silver coins, sugar, spices, tobacco and other merchandise when it met its match against the sea... This custom version of our 44mm diver uses bronze, stainless steel, carbon fiber, enameled steel and leather in a medley of material, color and texture that remembers myriad cargo lost on this ship's final voyage. Assembled in Encinitas, CA 🇺🇸 Ships With: - 44mm Stainless Steel Case + "Beast Mode" Carbon Fiber Bezel - Eta 2824 Movement With Custom Bronze Rotor - 22m Horween Leather Rally Strap - 22m Integrate Flourine Rubber Dive Strap - Travel Case - Certificate Of Authenticity - Sapphire Glass Cover & Sapphire Glass Display Caseback

watches.name: Everything Must Go - TSC X ADAM GREENER
watches.description: A collaboration with Los Angeles based Artist Adam Greener titled "Everything Must Go." This is the first of our "Take Over" collaborations where we hand over the keys to the car and let someone else drive it like they stole it...This limited collection celebrates one of Adam's newest pieces in his signature style. This work of Adam's is a candid flashback of a young boy's journey through the break up of his parents' marriage and the ensuing garage sale he was tasked to manage to get rid of all his dad's "stuff." The coming together of this collection combines a mixture of high end reproduction, handmade custom parts and craft art applied to our packaging. The result is a journey into pop art with a mashup of irreverence and attention to detail. Limited Edition Kit Includes: - 44mm Bronze Watch with Eta 2824 Swiss Movement - High Resolution Enamel Printed Dials - Each Dial Is A Different Vignette From The Artwork - Custom Reversible Leather Strap With Silk Printed Vignettes From The Artwork - Custom "Dad's Chair" Bespoke Strap - Sacred Crafts Bronze & Seaglass (Made From Reclaimed Fishing Nets) Adjustable Link Bracelet - Signed and Numbered High Resolution Cloth Print Reproduction Of The Artwork - Hand Decorated Luxury Wood Gift Box With Hand Applied Stickers Of Adam's Art & Decoupage Box Lining From Cut From Vintage Playboys - Custom Pencil Case Style Watch Travel Pouch - Sticker Pack Of Adam's Doodles - Certificate Of Authenticity - User Manual - 5 Year Warranty On Movement and Dial This is a hand made, collectible watch. Each dial and strap are unique. Please contact us for any special request, personalization or customization. Ships in 7 days. Fully insured, global shipping available.

Featuring a screwed down crown and unidirectional dive bezel this 25 jewel, 42 hour powered watch will perform as needed anywhere you feel free to roam. watches.name: Hua Hin - Bronze Case / Blue Legacy Dial
watches.description: Hua Hin is a celebration of our connection with the big blue. This crafted timepiece shares the story of a life on the sea. Hua Hin is a moment in time where sacred materials are reborn to live on. The case, bezel, links and crown are made from “Our Bronze” - a custom bronze formulation we developed from reclaimed bronze marine propellors. This model also features custom wood parts from our first vintage boat harvest in 2019. The dial is an ultra precise veneer made from the rootsiest part of the boat. The center links section is also made from the boat for a unique look to every watch. Hua Hin ships with a luxury reclaimed wood box made from our vintage boats, a rubber dive strap, premium leather band, travel case and coffee table book that shares the story of how [and why] we made this watch. Designed to wear with the wearer, a bronze watch is a special type of timepiece. Its color will gradually turn from a glowing warm bronze to a deep patina depending on where it's taken. Best of all, the patina can be removed and its original luster can be restored with a simple cleaning process. Featuring a screwed down crown and unidirectional dive bezel this 25 jewel, 42 hour powered watch will perform as needed anywhere you feel free to roam.
